title: This tiny AI voice recorder does all the hard work for you
excerpt: It's even better at its new lower price
content_html:
Published Aug 24, 2026, 7:20 PM EDT

Timi is the news and deals reporter for Android Police, who has been reporting on technology since 2008. He has worked in tech retail and also the IT space, providing hardware and software support, which gives him a unique perspective on the tech that he covers. This allows him to effectively break down complex subjects into easy-to-read pieces that even casual readers can enjoy. Before joining Android Police, he was a news writer for XDA, where he eventually transitioned to covering deals. He also worked as an editor and reporter for Neowin, where he covered news and attended major tech events like CES. He also reviewed phones, tablets, PC products, and other devices. In addition, he also created video content for the Neowin YouTube channel.

Sign in to your Android Police account

Want a convenient way to record your day? The Plaud NotePin voice recorder is a dedicated gadget that does just that. You get 20 hours of continuous voice recording. Plus, when you're looking through all the data later, you can use the "search" function to find just what you're looking for.

This voice recorder uses AI in several ways, so you get an experience that's better than your traditional voice recorder. It also makes sure it's not redundant compared to your phone. We reviewed it and found that the device was genuinely useful. We like that most of the necessary features were already included in the retail purchase price.

Something worth looking at

And while the retail price of $159 was decent, it's much easier to buy at the discounted price of $111. Best Buy is offering this discount, making it an easy pick. The device is small, light, and easy to use. It can also upload your data to the cloud.

You'll have a free plan for starters, but you can also pay for more storage and features if you want. While voice recording is a given, the device also creates transcripts and summaries. You can access these through the app or the web.

The device comes with a clip or a magnetic pin, so you can choose how you want to wear it. If you're not great at taking notes, or you need to keep track of your day, this device might help. We can easily see it being used at work, at home, or just on the fly throughout your day. Just remember to comply with your local rules when it comes to recordings.

Plaud NotePin

Plaud's portable, easy-to-use voice recorder - the NotePin - is a prime example of how a dedicated AI gadget can be useful day-to-day. Journalists, students, lawyers, and those needing to easily and intelligently record and summarize conversations should check out the NotePin
